items.title: Child Flying a Ghost Kite
items.alt: A child in an orange jacket runs while flying a smiling ghost-shaped kite with a long ribbon tail.
items.description: A child in an orange jacket runs while flying a smiling ghost-shaped kite with a long ribbon tail. Use this illustration for autumn outdoor play cards.
